start.text: You are the one testing phones at everyone's door? Good. Mine works — the tower is right there. One room, kitchen, attached bathroom, water at six. Rent nine thousand, deposit sixteen — two months, old rate. Manju told you? Then you know I don't bargain. Much.

choices.text: Can we talk about the price, Aunty?

see.text: See, see. The door is open. Red oxide floor — my husband did it in '94. Come back when you've seen.

price.text: Nine thousand rent. Sixteen thousand deposit — two months at what the last boy paid. Everybody on this hill pays this, and everybody on this hill has signal only in my house.

done.text: Done. Key is yours. Lock the gate after ten, no loud music, no non-veg smell on Thursdays — the Hanuman is downstairs. Welcome, kanna. Your own room.

walked.text: Think. But think fast — the maroon-door boy's cousin is also looking.

signed.text: Tank fills at six. If the light goes, the candle is on the loft shelf. Eat something.
